reviews.author: Matthew Huang
reviews.text: Edyta has been such a star and inspiration in our lives for the past year.

reviews.author: Tatiana K.
reviews.text: I didn't know I was into dancing before I tried these classes. Absolutely love it! Edyta is such a great coach!

reviews.author: Bay Area couple · tech
reviews.text: We had zero dance experience. Edyta made us look like we’d been practicing for years — our guests still talk about it.

reviews.author: First-time dancers
reviews.text: She broke everything down the way she does on TV. Patient, fun, and the studio felt private and calm.

reviews.author: SF wedding planner
reviews.text: As a planner, I send every couple who wants a first dance to Edyta. Professional, reliable, unforgettable.
